title: HealthPhoto
description: One private health image = one envelope, ACL [@owner]. The bytes are INLINE (data URI) by design: the platform blob store serves uploaded files from a public CDN regardless of the envelope ACL, so health imagery must not be stored there. Other envelopes (e.g. Meal) reference this envelope and never carry a second copy of the bytes.

subject.description: @-prefixed eName of the person this data is about

device.description: w3id (@eName) of the measuring device's OWN eVault, where its Device passport lives; null if unknown

provenance.description: Import provenance. Vendor identity lives HERE only (source), never in metric keys.

dedupKey.description: Writer's idempotency key, unique within this ontology on the vault

contentHash.description: Writer-maintained md5 of the payload; recomputed on every rewrite

md5.description: md5 of the bytes — dedup key for re-uploads of the same photo

purpose.description: What the photo is of, in neutral terms ("meal", "document", "other")
